text: App is good but why lock cost per km behind miles or subscription? Basic analytics should be free for everyday riders.
Tracking is accurate while screen is on. But background battery drain is too high during long breakfast rides.
Too complicated to earn Miles just to check my bike's service intervals. Make it straightforward without gamification.
We ride in a group of 8. It would be amazing if we could all see each other on a single live map instead of individual links.
Crashed twice during a 300km tour in Maharashtra ghats where network was patchy. Needs offline caching.
Decent app for log fuel, but I hate subscription models for maintenance reminders. I already bought my bike.
